name: Certain wallet addresses use certain services for free
asks: Configure it so certain wallet addresses can use certain services for free; aim toward it with the most upstream and coherent systems.

x-provenance.recorded-by: general-2 pass of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus (Red Cup Engineer Senior)

sources.words:
Oh I guess I'd also like to configure it so that certain wallet addresses can use certain services for free?

That'd be a cool feature, I'm not sure the best way to implement it with our most upstream and coherent systems, but it'd be good to aim toward.

board-opening.need: Certain wallet addresses use certain services for free

requirements.says: The x402 gateway shall serve a named service without payment to a request signed by a wallet address on that service's free-use list.
The free-use list shall be a derived record held at the service's owning section, not a list in gateway code.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-28: implement with the most upstream and coherent systems.
